title: Weeknight-Winning Veggie Grilled Cheese
steps: Heat a medium skillet over medium-low heat.
Spread the butter/mayo (if using) on one side of each piece of bread. Flip the bread over onto a cutting board.
Spoon the mashed sweet potato on one side of the bread. Sprinkle with shredded carrots.
Top the shredded carrots with 1-2 slices of cheese, then add the other piece of bread to make the sandwich.

Place the sandwich on the preheated skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes. Flip, press down gently with your spatula (helps the cheese hold it all together), and cook for another 2-3 minutes or until golden brown.
